messages:
maria_cs: Kestrel trial reporting bursts of 429s during SDK init after we flipped on ephemeral tokens. They see 3-8 parallel preflight calls on page load.

maria_cs: Example log: ```2026-04-05T09:12:41Z WARN preflight request=ephemeral status=429 body=\"rate_limited\" client=kestrel-web```

sam_eng: thanks. sounds like preflight fanout + aggressive TTL churn. do we know their token TTL and client retry logic?

maria_cs: TTL is 30s server-side; client refreshes if >25s remaining (old logic). They also call preflight from multiple mounted components.

sam_eng: that refresh window is inverted - should reuse until near expiry, not refresh early. recommend: 1) reuse tokens for at least 10s, 2) splay preflight (random 50-500ms), 3) fallback to client-side queue so only one inflight token exchange per origin.

elliot_support: I can assemble a short customer playbook and propose a 15m live walkthrough.

maria_cs: they asked for help now. can we scope a quick live fix we can demo: patch client to 1) cache and reuse token for 15s, 2) linear backoff on 429 with jitter.

sam_eng: yes, I'll prepare a tiny patch and a telemetry dashboard to watch 429 rate by client_id. snippet to splay:```js
const jitter = () => Math.random() * 450 + 50;
for (let i=0;i<6;i++) setTimeout(preflight, Math.floor(jitter() * i));
```

anna_sre: FYI ops: there was a minor token-cache change pushed 2026-04-05T08:30Z. Could be interacting. We can temporarily increase the trial tenant quota by 40% for 2h while we run the session. Needs SRE approval.

maria_cs: I'll open ticket SRE-8921 and request expedited approval, tagging product and the customer.

elliot_support: Playbook draft (will add to ticket): steps: 1) identify preflight callers in client (devtools), 2) reduce parallelism to 1 per origin w/ 15s local cache, 3) add 429 handling honoring Retry-After, 4) monitor metrics, 5) optional tenant bump.

sam_eng: also include a quick diagnostic: capture sample request headers and preflight timestamps so we can see clustering. I'll paste a curl example for capturing headers during the call.

sam_eng: ```bash
curl -v -H \"User-Agent: KestrelWeb/1.3.0\" -H \"x-client-id: kestrel-frontend\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/preflight
```

deploybot: note: no global feature flags changed. temporary quota bumps require SRE runbook SRE-ops-runbook-ephemeral-bump. Ticket created by maria_cs will speed this up. :rocket:

maria_cs: meeting set for 17:00 PT today. invite includes sam, elliot, anna, and the customer engineers.

elliot_support: during the walkthrough we'll push the small client patch to their sandbox and watch 429s drop. will include step-by-step code examples and the telemetry link.

sam_eng: after the session let's capture the pre/post 429 rates and update the onboarding KB with a short note: \"Avoid parallel preflight calls; splay and cache ephemeral tokens.\"

maria_cs: agreed. will follow up in SRE-8921 with results. closing this slack thread to avoid duplication, will reopen if new issues emerge. :white_check_mark:
